paragraphs: Microsoft Corporation is an American multinational technology conglomerate headquartered in Redmond, Washington. The company became influential in the rise of personal computers through software like Windows and has since expanded into areas such as Internet services, cloud computing, artificial intelligence and video gaming among others. A Big Tech company, Microsoft is the largest software company by revenue, one of the most valuable public companies, and one of the most valuable brands globally.

Founded in 1975 by Bill Gates and Paul Allen to market BASIC interpreters for the Altair 8800, Microsoft rose to dominate the PC operating system market with MS-DOS in the mid-1980s, followed by Windows. The company's 1986 initial public offering and the subsequent rise in its share price created three billionaires and an estimated 12,000 millionaires among Microsoft employees. Since the 1990s, it has increasingly diversified its business. Steve Ballmer replaced Gates as CEO in 2000. He oversaw the then-largest of Microsoft's corporate acquisitions in Skype Technologies in 2011, an increased focus on hardware that led to its first in-house PC line—the Surface—in 2012, and the formation of Microsoft Mobile through Nokia. Since Satya Nadella became CEO in 2014, the company has changed focus towards cloud computing and acquired LinkedIn in 2016. Under his direction, the company has expanded its video gaming business to support the Xbox brand, establishing the Microsoft Gaming division in 2022 and acquiring Activision Blizzard in 2023.

Microsoft has been dominant in the IBM PC–compatible operating system and office software suite markets since the 1990s. Its best-known software products are the Windows line of operating systems and the Microsoft Office and Microsoft 365 suite of productivity applications, which most notably include the Word word processor, Excel spreadsheet editor, and PowerPoint presentation program. Its flagship hardware products are the Surface lineup of PCs and the Xbox brand of video game consoles, the latter including the Xbox network. The company also offers online services such as Bing web search, the MSN web portal, the Outlook.com (Hotmail) email service, and the Microsoft Store.  In the enterprise and development fields, Microsoft most notably provides the Azure cloud computing platform, Microsoft SQL Server database software, and Visual Studio.

Microsoft became the third publicly traded U.S. company to be valued at over $1 trillion in April 2019. It has been criticized for monopolistic practices, and the company's software received criticism for problems with ease of use, robustness, and security. Microsoft has also been criticized for its role in providing services to Israel during the Gaza war.

people.name: Satya Nadella
people.title: Chairman and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Nadella became Chief Executive Officer in February 2014 and Chairman of the Board in June 2021. He joined Microsoft in 1992 and previously served as Executive Vice President, Cloud and Enterprise, and President, Server and Tools.
people.quote: Mr. Nadella was appointed Chairman of the Board in June 2021 and Chief Executive Officer in February 2014.

people.name: Judson B. Althoff
people.title: Chief Executive Officer, Microsoft Commercial Business
people.bio: Althoff became Chief Executive Officer, Microsoft Commercial Business in October 2025, after serving as Executive Vice President and Chief Commercial Officer since July 2021. He joined Microsoft in March 2013 as President of Microsoft North America.
people.quote: Mr. Althoff was appointed Chief Executive Officer, Microsoft Commercial Business in October 2025.

people.name: Amy L. Coleman
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer
people.bio: Coleman became Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer in March 2025, after serving as Corporate Vice President, Human Resources and Corporation Functions since January 2021. She joined Microsoft in 2009 and has held various positions of increasing authority.
people.quote: Ms. Coleman was appointed Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer in March 2025.

people.name: Amy E. Hood
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Hood became Chief Financial Officer in May 2013 and Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer in July 2013. She joined Microsoft in 2002 and served as Chief Financial Officer of the Microsoft Business Division from 2010 to 2013.
people.quote: Ms. Hood was appointed Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer in July 2013, subsequent to her appointment as Chief Financial Officer in May 2013.

people.name: Takeshi Numoto
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Marketing Officer
people.bio: Numoto became Executive Vice President and Chief Marketing Officer in October 2023, after serving as Executive Vice President and Commercial Chief Marketing Officer from March 2020. He joined Microsoft in 1997 and has held multiple roles in Windows Program Management and Office Marketing.
people.quote: Mr. Numoto was appointed Executive Vice President and Chief Marketing Officer in October 2023.

people.name: Bradford L. Smith
people.title: Vice Chair and President
people.bio: Smith became Vice Chair and President in September 2021, after serving as President and Chief Legal Officer since September 2015. He joined Microsoft in 1993 and previously served as Executive Vice President, General Counsel, and Secretary.
people.quote: Mr. Smith was appointed Vice Chair and President in September 2021.
